summary.result: Projections suggested that future climate of the study area would be much hotter than the baseline period with minor rainfall increments.
summary.background: PRECIS simulated delta-change climate projections under the A1B scenario were used to project future climate during two-time slices: 2030s (2021-2050) and 2060s (2051-2080) against baseline climatology (1980-2010).
summary.method: CROPWAT model was used to simulate future CWRs and IWRs of the crops.

summary_ko.background: PRECIS 모형은 A1B 시나리오에 따른 기후변화의 델타-변화 기후 예측을 시뮬레이션하여, 기초 기후학적 통계(1980-2010) 대비 2030대(2021-2050) 및 2060대(2051-2080) 두 개 시간 슬라이스의 미래 기후를 예측하였다.
